source.name: Colorado Parks and Wildlife — 2025 statewide harvest reports (per hunt code), linked from the CPW species statistics pages

notes: Deer, elk and pronghorn figures are CPW Big Game Harvest Survey ESTIMATES (voluntary sample survey extrapolated to licenses sold); moose, mountain goat and bighorn sheep come from mandatory harvest reports. One row per CPW hunt code (limited, private-land-only, OTC/unlimited and leftover hunts all included; CPW reports deer/elk/pronghorn only for Commission-approved hunts with enough survey responses). successPct is CPW's published Percent Success. daysPerHarvest = total recreation days / harvest for deer/elk/pronghorn; null for moose/goat/sheep (CPW publishes average days per hunter). No per-GMU all-methods totals are published (CPW's totals are per DAU), so every row is per hunt code. Unit "statewide" = statewide hunt codes (GMU 000, e.g. OTC). Sheep/goat units use CPW's S#/G# unit names. "few hunters responded" in a label = CPW's asterisk (low response; less reliable). Bighorn sheep includes Rocky Mountain and desert reports. Reports: ELK: "2025 Elk Statewide Harvest Final.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/8uno656mtu); DEER: "2025 Deer Statewide Harvest Final.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/wp8zjwayji); ANTELOPE: "2025 Pronghorn Statewide Harvest Final.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/exyzeatjnh); MOOSE: "2025 Statewide Moose Harvest.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/ys5s9jfslu); MTNGOAT: "2025 Statewide Mountain Goat Harvest.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/y9rdtyrc0i); BIGHORNSHEEP: "2025 Statewide Rocky Mountain Bighorn Sheep Harvest.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/ldjmdouboz); BIGHORNSHEEP: "2025 Statewide Desert Bighorn Sheep Harvest.pdf" (https://cpw.widencollective.com/assets/share/asset/u7pzqsklsh).
